name: Free Will Baptists

facts.value: 18th century, ministry of Paul Palmer. Yearly meeting of 16 churches 1752. National Association 1935

citations.locator: National Association of Free Will Baptists, group profile
citations.excerpt: The National Association of Free Will Baptists dates to the ministry of Paul Palmer in the American South in the 18th century. As Palmer's church grew and spread, a yearly meeting with 16 churches was formed in 1752.
The settlement from this event led to the formation of the National Association of Free Will Baptists in 1935.
